name: H3VR2 Infinite Ammo
author: fuchcar
description: Native IL2CPP mod for H3VR2 (Footlong): infinite ammo for every firearm type (magazine-fed, bolt-action, pump/tube shotgun, breach/derringer, revolver), removes felt recoil, and re-enables the game's built-in quickbelt duplication. Built on Scotland2 + flamingo.
